remarks: Spacious offices in the heart of Newfield. Current layout offers reception area + 5 separate offices/ rooms including two large enough to be conference rooms. Previously used as chiropractor office. Restroom is in common hallway. Total of up to 1,265 sf of Ground Floor Office Space. Can subdivide into 6 smaller units 100 sf to 1,265 sf. Rent will depend on size of space and term or lease. Great neighborhood convenient to Merritt (RT 15) and I95. Short drive to Newfield Green Shopping Center, Tully Medical Center, Sterling Farms Golf Course, a mile north of Stamford central business district. Public bus #33 for Strawberry Hill Ave stops across the street. Other office tenants include Real Estate/ Property Management, Physical Therapist, Insurance Agent, Verizon.
